descriptionByLocale.en:
Are you well organized? Do you have a sharp eye for detail? We’re looking for an intern to:

• support onboarding processes, including review and validation of hiring documentation
• assist with employee data entry and maintenance in payroll systems (e.g., ADP)
• support time and attendance control for interns and apprentices
• provide administrative support and employee inquiries
• assist with occupational health processes (e.g., scheduling medical exams)
• organize documentation related to HR administrative and labor processes
